source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary:
Once per turn, during your opponent's Shooting phase, if another **ADEPTUS ASTARTES** unit of yours is **destroyed** within 6" of one or more models in your army that have this ability, one of those models may use it. If one does:

- after all of the attacking unit's attacks are made, that model may shoot as though in your Shooting phase
- it can target only the attacking unit, and only if that unit is an eligible target

limit.scope: one model with this ability in your army

ability.timing: after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks

effect.shoot: as if it were your Shooting phase
effect.targetRestriction: only the attacking enemy unit, provided it is an eligible target

cardPrintsOtherText.name: Storm of Vengeance (Once per turn, per unit)
